formal_forward.meaning: 9/30 baseline/rehearsal may be diagnosed but is excluded from formal exit-policy qualification. First formal candidates are signal_date >= 2026-10-08.

structural_invalidation.frozen_source: Execution Funnel stop_raw derived from breakout level * (1 - 0.015)
structural_invalidation.rule: first post-entry session whose adjusted CLOSE is strictly below the frozen adjusted stop
structural_invalidation.execution: next tradable session OPEN; if suspended/missing valid open, defer until first valid open
structural_invalidation.intraday_wick_only: does not invalidate if close recovers above stop
structural_invalidation.ma20_loss_alone: diagnostic warning only; not an exit rule in V0.1

fixed_horizon_execution.scheduled_exit: exact CLOSE on the Nth subsequent market session after fire_date
fixed_horizon_execution.if_suspended_or_missing_close: defer to first subsequent valid close

hybrid_priority.rule: structural exit wins only when structural trigger_date is strictly before the scheduled horizon date; otherwise use horizon close
hybrid_priority.same_day: if trigger occurs on the scheduled horizon date, predetermined horizon CLOSE wins because structural signal is only known at that close

review_gate.reason: collect evidence first; do not invent a weighted score after observing results
